```toml
[target.i686-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]
winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu = "0.4"
```

`winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu` is the crate that ships the 32-bit MinGW import libraries (`libwinapi_*.a`) and its `build.rs` emits the matching `rustc-link-search` for that target. I verified it resolves with `cargo metadata --filter-platform i686-pc-windows-gnu` (pulls `winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu v0.4.0`).

Note: if the project uses the higher-level `winapi` crate, that crate already declares this exact target dependency in its own manifest, so you'd get it transitively; adding it explicitly is only needed when linking the Windows API bindings directly.
